_readme: R336 v2 — TRUE waivers only. The three Arabic adaptations (rtl-x-mirror, ar-letter-spacing-zero, ar-line-height-floor) are no longer exceptions: they are TRANSFORMED EXPECTATIONS inside tolerances.mjs (the expected value is computed through the adaptation, then compared with the same tolerance as any raw field — asserted, never waived). What stays here must be a real waiver with a reason, is counted per rule, and the total must stay <5% of all assertions. Today exactly one rule remains.

exceptions.rule: Text-length class may differ by ±1 class (none↔short↔medium↔long) where the Arabic copy is more compact than the English source.
exceptions.reason: Arabic copy is more compact than English
